title: Consume European White Flowers mixed switches
changes: Serve five authenticated Thumb switch destination arrays and five literal words from extracted resources while preserving previous owners and out-of-range behavior.
validation: Wine E391 readers pass 42 original interpreter/generated dispatches, 10 guards, 10 fallback and two literal cases, mirror and boundary reads, source authentication and snapshot preservation.
Wine E391 compares 700 altered-source White Flowers frames and production CLI create, reuse and verify; static join accounts for 80 sampled bytes. All Wine servers drained.
limitations: The E362 address-only sample leaves 3,630 unowned bytes, including 3,600 copied-code support; executing PCs, helper-return behavior and other scenes remain open.
Linux, USA and native Windows validation remain pending. No performance measurements were made.
